content.short: MINDS is an open-source social network focused on Internet freedom, rewarding daily MINDS Tokens (ERC-20) for popular content, referrals, or liquidity.
content.description: Minds is an open-source social network dedicated to Internet freedom and user-generated expression. Members earn MINDS Tokens (ERC-20) on a daily basis for creating engaging content, inviting friends, or supplying liquidity to the system. These tokens can be spent to promote posts (1 token = 1,000 impressions) or to tip creators, helping support their work and unlock exclusive perks. The platform operates across Ethereum, Polygon, Multichain, Base, and Solana networks.
